questions.question: 1. What is the main lobe of an antenna's radiation pattern?

answers.b: The direction of highest signal strength
answers.d: The physical base of the antenna

questions.question: 2. The '3dB beamwidth' is an angular measurement taken at which point?

answers.a: Where the signal strength is exactly 3 watts
answers.b: Where the signal strength drops to half its maximum power
answers.c: At the third sidelobe of the pattern
answers.d: At a distance of 3 meters from the antenna

questions.question: 3. What does the horizontal beam pattern of a base station antenna show?

answers.b: Signal coverage in the left-right (azimuth) plane
answers.d: The signal strength at the antenna's base

questions.question: 4. The vertical beam pattern is used to study the signal's strength in which plane?

answers.c: The plane parallel to the antenna's length

questions.question: 5. A base station antenna with a narrow horizontal beamwidth is often described as...?
6. What is 'antenna tilt' used to control?

answers.b: The vertical direction of the main beam
answers.c: The horizontal direction of the main beam
answers.d: The power consumption of the antenna

questions.question: 7. Calculating the beamwidth of the horizontal pattern helps to define what?

answers.a: How tall the antenna tower must be
answers.b: The width of the sector or area the antenna covers on the ground
answers.c: How far the signal travels upwards into the sky

questions.question: 8. Why is an antenna's vertical beam pattern studied?

answers.a: To aim the signal at users on the ground and avoid interference
answers.b: To see how wide the signal is in all directions
answers.c: To measure the antenna's physical tilt

answers.a: The most important part of the beam
answers.b: A useful, secondary signal for extra coverage
answers.c: An undesired part of the pattern that can cause interference
answers.d: The main signal beam, but viewed from the side

questions.question: 10. What does a 'tilt angle' of zero degrees typically mean in a vertical pattern?

answers.a: The main beam is pointed straight up
answers.b: The main beam is pointed straight down
answers.c: The main beam is pointed at the horizon
